met_analysis:
The Low Pressure Area over East Rajasthan & adjoining northwest Madhya Pradesh lies over northwest Madhya Pradesh & neighbourhoodat 0530 hrs IST of today, 12th August, 2026. The associated cyclonic circulation extends upto 5.8 km above mean sea level tilting southwards with height.
The Monsoon trough at mean sea level now passes through Bikaner, centre of Low Pressure Area over northwest Madhya Pradesh & neighbourhood, Satna, Jamshedpur, centre of Low Pressure Area over North Bay of Bengal off West Bengal-Bangladesh coasts and thence east-southeastwards into the Northeast Bay of Bengal and extends upto 1.5 km above mean sea level.
The Shear Zone roughly along Lat. 22°N across central & adjoining north Peninsular India between 3.1 & 7.6 km above mean sea level tilting southwards with height persists.
The Western Disturbance as a trough in middle tropospheric westerlies with its axis at 5.8 km above mean sea level roughly along Long. 68°E to the north of Lat. 30°N persists.
An upper air cyclonic circulation lies over northeast Assam & neighbourhood at 0.9 km above mean sea level.
